sandbachFocus: Sandbach United face a stern test in the FA Vase this Saturday, taking on higher-level opposition Ashby Ivanhoe at home (3pm kick-off). The Bach come into the tie on the back of a disappointing 3-1 midweek defeat to New Mills, where they conceded from an awkward bounce late on after squandering chances and giving away set-piece goals. Manager JKD has called on supporters to back the team vocally this weekend as they look to bounce back in cup competition.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals saw their perfect start ended by Eccleshall in a 2-1 midweek reverse, with Max Chimenes and Morgan Russell securing the win despite Cassies pulling one back through Kieran Cook. Shawbury United enjoyed a seven-goal thriller away at Allscott Heath, running out 4-3 winners in an entertaining contest featuring goals from Harvey Lewis and Ethan Pickford. AFC Bridgnorth maintained their strong form with a 1-1 draw at Wednesfield Community before hosting Crewe this Saturday, while league leaders New Mills secured a convincing 3-1 away victory at Sandbach to consolidate their position at the top. Stafford Town's recent form included a midweek 3-2 comeback win over Alsager Town after going down to ten men, followed by an FA Vase clash this Saturday. Telford Town recorded a 3-2 comeback win over Alsager in their recent outing and face Darlaston in the FA Vase. Foley Meir showed attacking prowess with a 3-0 away win at Crewe FC in midweek and welcome Redditch Borough in the FA Vase.
